name: agent-cli-plugins
description: Agent-optimized CLIs for Apple Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders and Paperless-ngx, each with a Claude Code skill and policy guard, plus a shared agent-cli skill.

plugins.name: agent-cli
plugins.description: Shared skill and session-start detection for all agent-cli tools.

plugins.name: apple-mail
plugins.description: Apple Mail: read and triage mail; never sends.

plugins.name: apple-notes

plugins.name: apple-calendar
plugins.description: Apple Calendar: events and search; policy-gated create/update/delete.

plugins.name: apple-reminders
plugins.description: Apple Reminders: lists and due tasks; policy-gated add/complete.

plugins.name: paperless
plugins.description: Paperless-ngx: search, read and download documents; policy-gated upload/tagging.
